I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is **Gate 47**.

Pree first posted Dock 23 in that channel on Oct 14, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning. Nobody has changed it in the channel since. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only used messages they can already see there.
